boundary: The state machine, verifier, bundled gates, safety hook, trace protocol, and optional run-view are packaged in this skill. Peer research skills and user/network/tool providers are explicit external providers.

external_providers.peer_scholar_skills: Required phase engines; dispatched explicitly and not imported as runtime helpers.
external_providers.zotero_or_local_library: Optional citation provider; set SCHOLAR_ZOTERO_DIR. Unavailable providers must report YELLOW/UNAVAILABLE.
external_providers.crossref_and_web: Optional network citation providers; unavailability must be explicit.
external_providers.analysis_and_rendering_tools: R and method-specific tools are phase-dependent. Phase 19/20 authenticity verification requires Pandoc plus Poppler pdfinfo/pdftotext/pdftoppm; TeX generation requires a declared engine such as XeTeX. Missing required format tools produce BLOCKED/FAIL, never PASS.
